text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is still some time before
training...
I should
review my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes. There will be a quiz during
math class on
this day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like I scheduled enough
study time the day before the quiz, so I
should extend that
session by thirty
minutes...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I reduce my evening workout by thirty
minutes,
then that should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But wait, I could make up for that time by
extending my workout on a different
night. What
do I have scheduled for the
prior week?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can't get my schedule to line up
correctly...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps redoing it from square one is
the best
course of action.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can't train perfectly without the
perfect

schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash becomes so engrossed in
fixing her
schedule that she completely
forgets about
today's training session.
